At most 8 seconds. The function's own timeout can be longer. The flow still takes the Error or Timeout branch at 8 seconds.

A flat object of string keys and string values. One of the two Lambda response shapes.

What a user may do in the admin site and the CCP. Different from an IAM policy.

The browser cannot open media to TurnNlb on UDP 3478. Fix: Allow outbound UDP 3478 to TurnNlb-*.elb.region.amazonaws.com and retest with the Endpoint Connectivity tool.
ICE candidate collection timed out, so the CCP never built a media channel. Fix: Check DNS, UDP 3478, and whether a VPN or proxy is hairpinning media.
Signaling works and RTP or WebRTC media does not, often because of NAT or a stateless firewall. Fix: Allow the browser ephemeral range on a stateless firewall. Avoid VPN for media.

cards.front: Lambda AccessDenied in the flow log
cards.back: The function is not associated with the instance, or the resource policy does not allow connect.amazonaws.com. Fix: Add the function to the instance and grant lambda:InvokeFunction to connect.amazonaws.com.

cards.front: Lambda runs 10 seconds and the flow takes Error
cards.back: Synchronous invoke waits at most 8 seconds even if the function timeout is 15. Fix: Return faster, or use asynchronous mode and a Wait block. A sequence of Lambda calls must stay within 20 seconds.

cards.front: Response is not a string map
cards.back: The function returned nested JSON while the block expects a flat string map, or the payload exceeds 32 KB. Fix: Match the block response validation. Keep values to the characters Connect accepts.

cards.front: You've reached the limit of Phone Numbers
cards.back: Can appear on the first claim. The default quota is 10, but new accounts still need Support for some telephony limits. Fix: Open a Support case. Do not keep retrying the claim.

cards.front: Fast busy on a campaign call
cards.back: Concurrent campaign active calls default to 0. Fix: Request a quota increase before the campaign start.

cards.front: Chat API quota exceeded while agents look idle
cards.back: Idle chats still count against the 500 concurrent chat quota. Fix: Use persistent chat where it fits, and alarm on concurrent chats.
Bucket policy, KMS key policy, or the flow never enabled recording. Fix: Check the Set recording block, the storage config, and the key policy for the Connect service.

cards.front: CTR not in the bucket after one minute
cards.back: Firehose buffers. Five quiet minutes is the documented point to start worrying. Fix: Check the delivery stream errors and the S3 prefix.

cards.front: SAML user has no routing profile
cards.back: The assertion did not map a routing profile, security profile, or role the instance accepts. Fix: Map the attributes your identity provider sends. Test with one user before a cutover.

cards.front: Flow error with no customer-facing branch
cards.back: An error output is disconnected, so Connect terminates the contact. Fix: Connect every error, timeout, and default branch. Turn on flow logs first.

cards.front: Transfer to queue does nothing useful
cards.back: Set working queue was skipped, or it sits after the transfer. Fix: Set the queue, then transfer. In a customer queue flow, Transfer to queue moves an already queued contact.

cards.front: Agents in the wrong queue receive the contact
cards.back: The routing profile priority and delay, not the queue name alone, decide eligibility. Fix: Lower number is higher priority. Delay holds the contact away from a profile until the timer expires.

Numbers must be in a traffic distribution group. In Tokyo, only numbers enabled for Global Resiliency fully replicate to Osaka, and Osaka delivery can take up to 20 seconds. Fix: Associate numbers before the failover test. Treat Osaka as a replica Region.

cards.front: Custom CCP loads and audio never starts
cards.back: Streams can run media-less. Media still needs the softphone allow list. Fix: Init the CCP with softphone options and test UDP 3478.

cards.front: Error rate above 2 percent after a domain allow list
cards.back: Option 1 can fail when a proxy cannot resolve the WebSocket or TURN domains. Fix: Test more than 200 calls. If the error rate stays above 2 percent, review proxy resolution or use the IP-range option.

cards.front: Email thread split into a new contact
cards.back: Replies after 90 days start a new thread. Active email contacts expire at 14 days unless you set connect:ContactExpiry, and never beyond 90. Fix: Set the expiry attribute deliberately.

cards.front: Voice ID block still in a flow after May 2026
cards.back: Support ended 20 May 2026. New customers stopped 20 May 2025. Fix: Remove Set Voice ID and Check Voice ID. Use a partner or a one-time password via End User Messaging SMS.

cards.front: Midnight callers reach a closed queue that the prompt calls open (4)

cards.back: Hop: Override.

cards.back: Cause: The override does not include that date, or the quota of 50 overrides hid the one you needed.

cards.back: Cause: The page origin is not allowed for the widget.

cards.back: Hop: Transfer.

cards.back: Hop: WFM.

cards.front: A home agent's 911 address is the headquarters (4)
cards.back: Capture: 933 readback.
